name: BODY-CARD-never-upright
note: The switch read by nothing: the Billboard Look on, every body still leans.

name: BODY-CARD-the-lean-it-was-handed-lost
note: The Billboard Look takes the travel view's leaned bodies level too: its lean is the view's, not the body's.

name: BODY-CARD-on-by-default
old: control: Object.freeze({ store: 'prefs', key: 'mwBillboardLook', initial: false, online: 'player' }),
new: control: Object.freeze({ store: 'prefs', key: 'mwBillboardLook', initial: true, online: 'player' }),
note: Every body upright out of the box - BODY-LEAN's report back for every player who never asked for it.

name: BODY-CARD-another-key
note: The card reads a key the row never writes: the switch does nothing.

name: BODY-FLAT-picture-pitched
note: The card upright, its picture down the pitched ray again: cos(pitch) of the body, and a sliver up close.

name: BODY-FLAT-ray-short-of-unit
old: const dist = flat ? lvl : Math.max(0.5, Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz));
new: const dist = Math.max(0.5, Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz));
note: A body nearly straight below the eye: the level ray short of unit, the picture's own camera inside its box.

name: BODY-FLAT-no-heading-straight-over
old: const camDir = flat && !(lvl > 1e-6) ? levelHeading(view) : [dx / dist, dy / dist, dz / dist];
new: const camDir = [dx / dist, dy / dist, dz / dist];
note: Straight over the body there is no level ray: NaN through the picture's camera.
